create_DetectionModelHelper: create a DetectionModelHelper instance to build a Detectron object detection model with configurable training mode
build_TrainableParams: build a list of trainable parameter blob names filtered by GPU id for model optimization
generate_RPN_proposals: generate RPN region proposals from anchor boxes and predicted deltas using GenerateProposals
transform_RoI_features: transform RoI features using RoIPoolF or RoIAlign pooling with optional FPN multi-level support
update_learning_rate: update the model learning rate and correct momentum blobs across all GPUs with UpdateWorkspaceLr
